newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel slams Palestinian official over flag slur.
newsitem.headline: Israel slams Palestinian official over flag slur.

text.p: Israel slammed Palestinian Legislative Council speaker Ahmed Korei on Saturday for trampling on an Israeli flag during a protest in the West Bank city of Ramallah.
"It's a shameful angering act, one which angers every Israeli and every Jew," Israeli Cabinet Secretary Danny Naveh told Israel Channel Two television.

"Anyone who lends his hand to the burning of the Israeli flag or tramples on the flag also tramples with his very foot on the prospects for building trust and for building peace between Palestinians and the State of Israel," Naveh said.
Korei led about 1,000 Palestinians in the demonstration in the West Bank city of Ramallah against the expansion of Jewish settlements.
Witnesses said Korei stood by while Palestinian youths burned an Israeli flag and then walked on its charred remnants.
Protesters at the rally called for Israel to stop its expansion of settlements and held signs demanding the United States to "stop supporting the Israeli occupation".
"This is a message to the Israelis to let them know there can be no peace with settlements and that the Palestinian people have other choices," Korei told Reuters at the demonstration.
